نستغني (form X)
# نَسْتَغْنِي (nastaḡnī) /nas.taɣ.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# نَسْتَغْنِيَ (nastaḡniya) /nas.taɣ.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
